messages:
Marta - Procurement: Vendor sent renewal + an unexpected overage credit reversal on last invoice. Can we triage before we sign? Link: https://drive.google.com/qclear-renewal. @Alex @Sanjay

Alex (Finance): What was the credit amount and why reversed? We need dates and invoice IDs.

Marta - Procurement: Excerpt: 
Invoice 2026-04-12: credit $4,200 applied for reported downtime. Credit reversed on 2026-04-20 with note 'metering dispute resolved'. No further detail.

QuotaClear Rep: Sorry for the confusion. Our billing team reversed the credit after internal reconciliation; they believed the outage window fell under scheduled maintenance. We can re-open the dispute and provide the outage logs.

Sanjay (ML Eng): From our telemetry the service experienced 45 minutes of elevated error rates on Apr 9 that impacted embedding jobs. If you can share timestamps/logs we'll correlate.

Alex (Finance): We need a clear audit trail: meter logs, incident timeline, and a remediation credit proposal. Also include how future credits are handled in renewals.

Marta - Procurement: Also question the renewal pricing — their committed plan has higher fixed cost than our forecasted usage. Before re-approving, we want either a hybrid with usage overlay or a write-down of last invoice if outage impacted us.

QuotaClear Rep: Understood. We'll: (1) re-open billing dispute and provide meter logs + outage window evidence, (2) offer a one-time goodwill credit if evidence supports customer impact, (3) include a clause in renewal for credits tied to SLA breaches, and (4) draft a hybrid quote (3 seats + 150M pool + usage overlay). Will send revised quote and dispute docs by EOD.

Procurement-Bot: Created PR #512: "QuotaClear billing dispute & renewal". Approvers requested: Alex (Finance), Legal, Security. Link: https://procurement.internal/pr/512

Marta - Procurement: Thanks. Alex, please review the sample invoice once they send it; SAnjay please validate the outage timestamps against our telemetry. We'll pause signing until we have docs. :thumbsup:
